body_lead: VIJAYAWADA: Director General of Police (DGP) Harish Kumar Gupta has warned that stringent legal action will be taken against individuals who misuse social media platforms to spread misinformation, hatred, or content intended to tarnish the image of people and institutions. In a press release on Wednesday, the DGP said some individuals are misusing social media to disturb law and order in the State and they have been identified.
